verified_facts.text: The resort is in the Dhaalu Atoll in the Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Baglioni Maldives, in the Dhaalu Atoll, every day unfolds in a dreamlike setting.

verified_facts.text: Guests reach the resort by a 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The most incredible part of your journey will be the 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport, complete with spectacular views.

verified_facts.text: The resort operates on an all-inclusive basis.
verified_facts.excerpt: All Inclusive Barefoot Luxury at Baglioni Maldives

verified_facts.text: The villas combine traditional architecture and local materials with touches of Italian style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our villas combine traditional architecture and local materials with refined elegance and subtle touches of Italian style.

verified_facts.text: Water Villas sit on stilts over the resort lagoon, linked to the island by a raised wooden walkway.
verified_facts.excerpt: villas on stilts over the resort lagoon, linked to the island by a raised wooden walkway. Our Water Villas are ideal for gazing out at the crystalline ocean waters.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Villa is set directly on the beach, surrounded by tropical vegetation, a few steps from the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set directly on the beach, surrounded by tropical vegetation and just a few steps from the sea, the Beach Villa is an intimate and light-filled retreat

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Family Beach Villa With Pool has two bedrooms, direct beach access and a private pool, designed for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: With two bedrooms, direct beach access and a private pool, it is designed to welcome families in a relaxed and private setting.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Baglioni Maldives Villa has three bedrooms and panoramic terraces overlooking the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort’s most exclusive residence, featuring three bedrooms, generous indoor and outdoor spaces, and panoramic terraces overlooking the ocean.

verified_facts.text: La Limonaia serves Southern Italy-inspired fine dining in an oceanfront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Southern Italy-inspired fine dining, where tradition and modern artistry blend seamlessly in a stunning oceanfront Maldivian setting.

verified_facts.text: Yama serves Japanese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Japanese cuisine meets ingredients from near and far culinary traditions, breathing life into new refined flavors.

verified_facts.text: Fuego is a beachside barbecue serving grilled meat and fish at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: A beachside barbecue where you can enjoy savory grilled meat and fish specialties while admiring the sunset.

verified_facts.text: Taste offers a daily international selection, with evenings devoted to Indian Ocean and Middle Eastern traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each day presents a diverse international selection, with evenings devoted to the rich traditions of the Indian Ocean and the Middle East.

verified_facts.text: In-villa dining is available from 6:00 am to midnight, with meals included in the all-inclusive plan.
verified_facts.excerpt: From 6:00 am to Midnight, you can enjoy our rich menu offerings every day from the comfort of your Villa, with all meals included in your all-inclusive plan.

verified_facts.text: Floating breakfast is not included in the all-inclusive plan.
verified_facts.excerpt: (Floating breakfast is not included in the All-Inclusive plan.)

verified_facts.text: A Pizza Boat serves freshly baked pizza by the pool or seaside from a specially crafted oven.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor a freshly baked pizza by the pool or seaside, prepared in our specially crafted oven for an unforgettable dining experience.

verified_facts.text: The Maagau Dive Centre offers dives to explore coral reefs, manta rays and sea turtles, for every age and experience level.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Maagau Dive Centre, expert instructors guide you through unforgettable underwater adventures for every age and experience level

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a whale shark snorkeling excursion in the Dhaalu Atoll.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the Maldives, in the heart of the Dhaalu Atoll, and swim alongside the whale shark—the gentle giant of the ocean.

verified_facts.text: A children's diving experience with a certified instructor goes to a maximum depth of 2 meters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accompanied by a certified instructor, young guests can have their first encounter with marine life and learn the fundamentals of diving, up to a maximum depth of 2 meters.

verified_facts.text: Boat excursions include a sandbank excursion, dolphin watching and Maldivian fishing at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Dolphin Watching Tour**

verified_facts.text: The resort has the Baglioni Aura Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt:
**Baglioni Aura Spa** \\
\\
Relax and regenerate body and soul, with rituals & treatments unique to our resort.

verified_facts.text: The resort holds Green Globe Certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn more about our actions and our Green Globe Certification (GGC).

verified_facts.text: International flights and transfers are not included; guests book flights to Velana International Airport on Malé Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll need to book your flights to Velana International Airport, located on Malé Island (flights & transportation are not included).

verified_facts.text: Seaplane baggage allowance is a 25 kg suitcase plus 5 kg hand luggage per guest, with extra baggage subject to a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: 25 kg (55 lbs.) suitcase + 5 kg (11 lbs.) hand luggage
